mentions.name: Devlens
mentions.description: Devlens visualizes React / Next.js codebases as an interactive graph so developers can understand how features and components connect without manually tracing files. Main focus areas are PR reviews (understanding the blast radius / impact of changes), onboarding to large codebases, and understanding unfamiliar parts of a system faster. It is also experimenting with summaries and security analysis directly on components.
mentions.problem: Understanding how features and components connect in a codebase currently requires manually tracing files.
mentions.audience: Developers reviewing PRs and onboarding to large React / Next.js codebases
mentions.source_excerpt:
